Katong & Joo Chiat 7 places · area 1 of 1

  1. 1 Must see within Katong & Joo Chiat · Laksa

    328 Katong Laksa

    The definitive Katong laksa that 'beat' Gordon Ramsay; former Michelin Bib, cut noodles eaten with a spoon.

    51 East Coast Road, Katong

    Recommended by , ,

  2. 2 Must see within Katong & Joo Chiat · Kaya Toast

    Chin Mee Chin Confectionery

    101-year-old Hainanese kopitiam; iconic round charcoal kaya buns, reopened 2021.

    204 East Coast Road, Katong/Joo Chiat

    Recommended by , ,

  3. 3 Must see within Katong & Joo Chiat

    Koon Seng Road Peranakan Shophouses (Joo Chiat/Katong)

    Singapore's most photographed row of pastel Peranakan shophouses (1920s) in the Katong-Joo Chiat conservation area.

    Look for Heritage

    Koon Seng Road, Joo Chiat

    Recommended by ,

  4. 4 Must see within Katong & Joo Chiat · Peranakan / Nyonya

    Guan Hoe Soon Restaurant

    Singapore's oldest Peranakan restaurant (1953); traditional Nonya cooking, third generation.

    38/40 Joo Chiat Place, Joo Chiat

    Recommended by ,

  5. 5 Must see within Katong & Joo Chiat · Indian

    Mr & Mrs Mohgan's Super Crispy Roti Prata

    Cult super-crispy prata cooked to order; long morning queues, 'cult status entirely affirmed'.

    300 Joo Chiat Road (Tin Yeang Coffeeshop)

    Recommended by ,

  6. 6 Worth the detour within Katong & Joo Chiat · Bak Kut Teh

    Sin Heng Claypot Bak Koot Teh

    40-year-old claypot bak kut teh with pepper & garlic; a 2025 Michelin Bib Gourmand.

    #01-01, 439 Joo Chiat Road, Joo Chiat

    Recommended by , ,

  7. 7 Worth the detour within Katong & Joo Chiat · Hawker

    Kway Guan Huat Joo Chiat Popiah

    Since 1938; hand-made popiah skins spun on a wooden pole, a Joo Chiat heritage name.

    95 Joo Chiat Road, Joo Chiat
